sentences.text: 1 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The prayer in the writ petition is made for direction upon the respondent no. 6 to pay the compensation amount with regard to acquired land of the petitioner in Land Acquisition Case 16/86-87 under Land Acquisition Act, 1894 for the purpose of Swarnreskha Reservoir under mouza Muru, village Mahuldih, Khata No. 284, plot no. 112, 116, 122-126, 134, 149, 150, 151, 152, 154, 159,
160, 161, 167, 175, 203, 235, 148, admeasuring 4.75 acres.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is land looser and notice has been issued to the father of the petitioner however no compensation has been made.
He submits that the petitioner has already moved before the respondent no.6 however no decision has been taken as yet.
4. Learned counsel for the State submits that petitioner may move before the respondent no.6 who will look into the grievance of the petitioner 5.

In view of above this petition is being disposed of directing the petitioner to file petition before the respondent no. 6 along with all the credentials within a period of two weeks and if such petition is filed within the aforesaid period the respondent no. 6 will examine the same and will pass a reasoned order in accordance with law within four weeks further thereafter.
6. This writ petition is disposed of.
Pending I.A, if any, stands disposed of.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Satyarthi/
